map.根据墙面尺寸、壁纸规格与对花损耗计算所需壁纸卷数: Compute required wallpaper rolls by wall size, wallpaper spec and pattern-match waste
map.📖 查看「壁纸用量计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Wallpaper Quantity Calculator
map.贴壁纸幅数 = 墙面总长 ÷ 幅宽（常见 0.53 m），向上取整；每卷可裁幅数: Wallpaper panels = total wall length ÷ panel width (common 0.53 m), rounded up; panels per roll = roll length ÷ (wall height + pattern-match waste, add 0.1–0.3 m per repeat for patterned) then floored; required rolls = panels ÷ panels per roll × (1 + waste rate 5% to 10%), rounded up; total wall length = room perimeter − total door/window width.
map.= 墙面总长 ÷ 幅宽（向上取整）: = total wall length ÷ panel width (rounded up)
map.= 墙高 + 对花花距（对花需每幅多裁一个花距）: = wall height + pattern repeat (patterned needs one extra repeat per panel)
map.= 贴壁纸幅数 ÷ 每卷可裁幅数（向上取整，再加损耗）: = wallpaper panels ÷ panels per roll (rounded up, plus waste)
map.• 门窗面积按扣减处理，复杂造型建议多备 1 卷: • Door/window area is deducted; for complex shapes keep 1 extra roll
map.• 同批次同花色一次购齐，避免色差: • Buy one batch of the same color/pattern at once to avoid color difference
map.整墙贴壁纸：输入墙宽高与壁纸幅宽/幅长，按「墙高÷幅长向上取整×墙宽÷幅宽」得幅: Full-wall wallpapering: enter wall width/height and wallpaper width/length, get panels by wall height ÷ roll length rounded up × wall width ÷ panel width, then convert to rolls.
map.对花壁纸：有循环花距需每幅对齐，额外加花距损耗，卷数上浮。: Patterned wallpaper: a repeating pattern needs each panel aligned, add extra repeat waste, rolls go up.
map.多墙合计：逐墙算后汇总，预留 1–2 卷同批次补货避免色差。: Multi-wall total: sum after per-wall computation, reserve 1–2 rolls of the same batch for replenishment to avoid color difference.
map.示例：墙宽 3.6m、高 2.7m，壁纸幅宽 0.53m、幅长 10m，损耗 5: Example: wall width 3.6 m, height 2.7 m, wallpaper width 0.53 m, roll length 10 m, waste 5%.
map.单卷壁纸的可用长度（常见 10m/卷），决定每卷能裁几幅。: The usable length of a single roll (common 10 m/roll), deciding how many panels it can yield.
map.有花距的壁纸每幅对齐花型会浪费一段，按花距加损耗，通常卷数上浮 1 卷。: Wallpaper with a repeat wastes a segment per panel for alignment; add waste by repeat, usually one extra roll.
map.买少了能补同色吗？: Can you replenish the same color if short?
map.不同批次壁纸易有色差，建议一次买足并多备 1–2 卷，宁可多不退。: Different batches easily show color difference; buy enough at once and keep 1–2 extra rolls; better extra than short.
